desc:
🌾 Grow, Build, and Explore in Farmtown! 🐄🌻

    🌽 Grow crops, harvest produce, and build your dream farm

    🐕 Raise animals: cows, chickens, dogs, sheep

    🏡 Decorate your farmstead with fences, flowers, fountains, and more

    ⛏️ Live a self-sufficient and sustainable lifestyle by mining your own ore by hand and crafting what you need

    🤝 Play and build together with friends in real time

    🌟 Cozy gameplay for fans of farming and open-world sims

    🚫 No excessive monetization, just chill fun!

Welcome to Farmtown, a relaxing multiplayer farming simulation where you create, grow, and explore at your own pace.

Plant a wide variety of crops and customize your farm however you like. Invite friends to build and tend your land together - harvesting, mining, and decorating in sync.

Wander the world to discover helpful people, hidden jobs, and new adventures. Earn money to expand, or just relax and enjoy the simple life.

🎨 No AI art, everything is handmade with care.
